title: A code block can keep a margin after its longest line
body:
`FormatBuilder::code_margin(n)` keeps `n` columns free at the end of a code block's header row. coax needs room for its copy glyph on every row of the block: it lays a kept block out at its longest line plus the gutter plus `COPY_ROOM`, and puts the glyph on the first body row when the block has no language and so no header row. So coax still measures the block itself in `kept_whole` in `src/ui.rs`.

## Proposal

`code_margin` keeps its columns free after the longest line on every row of the block, not only in the header. A block with no language under it then still has the room coax draws into.
